_comment: Copy to dashboard.config.json (gitignored) and fill in the paths for your
machine. Every key is OPTIONAL: with no config file at all the dashboard
still builds and serves -- the features that need a path disable
themselves and say which key to set, rather than guessing or crashing.
Precedence for every key:  environment variable  >  this file  >  default.
Two keys reuse an environment variable that other tools in this repo
already honour, so a single export configures all of them:
Nothing secret belongs here -- API keys live in the repo-root .env.
_work_dir: Where the collector writes its outputs. Only used to build the copy-pasteable per-region commands shown in the UI, and to locate grid_runs when data/data_root.txt is absent. Unset renders as '<work-dir>'.
_image_dir: Download target for new images, again only for the generated commands. Unset renders as '<image-dir>'.
_sweep_python: Interpreter for the detection sweep -- it needs torch, TensorRT and ultralytics, which the dashboard itself does not. Defaults to the interpreter running the dashboard, which is correct for a single-env checkout.
_dogbin_dataset: Built dog/not_dog crop dataset, used only by the review page's balance tracker. No default: unset, the panel says so. The directory is expected to hold train/{dog,not_dog} and val/{dog,not_dog}.
_grid_csv: Grid definition named in the generated commands. The default is almost certainly what you want.
_proxies: Proxy list named in the generated coverage-audit command. Default 'proxies.txt' (gitignored at the repo root).
triage_python: <path to a python with torch and transformers, for the crop guesser>
